title: Riot X Nic Salts Cherry Colada 10ml E-Liquid
description: Cherry Colada from Riot X reimagines the classic Cherry Cola profile with a cooler, more refined edge. Juicy Cherry notes bring a syrupy depth balanced by the sparkle of cola and a streak of cooling Menthol. The result is a layered vape with a fresh twist and bold finish. This e-liquid features Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine formula — a combination of freebase and nicotine salts — for fast-acting relief, discreet vapour, and a smooth throat hit. Its 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping using pod kits and starter devices. Riot X Nic Salts are made in the UK and deliver double-concentrated, bar-style flavour in a wide range of inventive blends. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
